purpose: Governed provisioning and pre-auth boundary for an independent Web-AI Army Cluster B profile.
provisioning_invariants: Target cluster root must be a new absolute dedicated path and must not pre-exist.
Existing path components must not traverse symlinks.
The browser profile directory is created mode 0700 and is empty before first browser start.
No source profile path is accepted by the provisioning API.
No Cluster A file, cookie, token, session database, storage value, OAuth callback material or credential value is copied, inspected, exported, hashed or compared.
A broker lock must be exclusive and the browser owner model remains one long-lived Chromium process per cluster profile.
Browser routes remain bounded by max_tabs=8 and later consume FA-302 tab leases.
Cluster B is not inserted into the active routing registry until Founder auth handoff is closed and broker/readiness verification is complete.

rollback.reason: After auth begins, the profile may contain Founder-created session material and must never be auto-deleted by generic rollback.
